  CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'existe'
    ELSE 'n_existe_pas'
  END AS statut
FROM brand_results3
WHERE search_domain ='{{ $json.raw.MARQUE }}'

where validated=1 and brand_icon not like  "http%"

    UPPER(TRIM(search_domain)) AS marque_base
